build_CohereRerankV2Config: build a CohereRerankV2Config instance to configure Cohere rerank v2 API calls
get_complete_url: build the complete Cohere rerank v2 API URL from an optional custom api_base and model string
get_supported_cohere_rerank_params: get the list of supported Cohere rerank parameters for a given model
map_cohere_rerank_params: map rerank input parameters into a structured OptionalRerankParams dictionary
transform_rerank_request: transform rerank request parameters into a serialized JSON-compatible dict for the Cohere API
